Re-read against the code 2026-10-02: each element that passed on a component name alone is partial, because the name proves a function exists, not that the design is met; presence holds the anchored component definition and evidence names what is drawn and missing. Q338 A (2026-10-02) fixes the correctness gaps now (silent gate and send failures, the false receipt, the zero-session dead end, the thread opening at the top, artifacts counted as files, the transparent command block, the false comment-anchor copy) and leaves visual parity, tablet type sizes included, to S3.5. SL-7 (2026-10-12) fixes them; the deny explanation the tablet receipt drops stays open (thread.receipt). The cellular frame reaches the machine over Domovoi Cloud, the Phase 2 relay (M2), so it is blocked.
